questions.question: रामायणे प्रितपािदतं िचत्ररचनां प्रित िववृणुत। Describe the art of painting in Ramayana. / [CO1]
questions.solution_html: • In the Ramayana, painting is not described directly in a detailed manner. However, in the descriptions of nature—forests, mountains, rivers, and seasons—the narration is experienced like a painting.In the description of royal palaces, the palaces in Ayodhya and Lanka were extremely rich and splendid. There are indications that they were adorned with wall paintings and decorations.In the description of ornaments and embellishments, the royal palace of Ravana in Lanka is depicted as golden and filled with pictorial beauty. The Pushpaka Vimana is also described as highly decorated and artistically designed. [U] [CO1]

questions.question: नारायणमुिनः िकमथ उवशीं सृज्यते ? Narayana created Urvasi for ? / [CO3]
questions.solution_html: • The sages Nara-Narayana were performing intense tapas (penance) at Badarik āś rama. Indra, fearing that their austerity might threaten his position, sent celestial nymphs (apsar ā s) to disturb them.To demonstrate their spiritual power and detachment, N ā r ā ya ṇ a Muni created an extraordinarily beautiful woman from his own thigh (uru).This maiden surpassed all the apsar ā s in beauty; hence she was named Urvashi (born from the thigh).The humbled apsar ā s returned, and Urva śī was then sent to Indra’s court. [U] [CO3]
